name: Point-wise Inverse Discrete Wavelet Transform (PW-IDWT) via Generalized Projection
definition: A procedure to determine the set of wavelet coefficients needed for a point-wise inverse discrete wavelet transform (PW-IDWT) by calculating the 'Generalized Projection' (GP) of a sample into the transformed domain. It solves the problem of identifying which coefficients at a coarser level contribute to a specific sample at a finer level during synthesis.
